objective: Retomar Gate 11 de Cavas Corporativas con un contrato determinista valido y estrictamente READ_ONLY_SQL. Auditar fisicamente el esquema canonico existente antes de disenar Gates 12-17: usuarios/RBAC/sesiones, clientes, CavaSocios/CavasCorporativas, mesas/comandas/meseros, inventario fisico/medicion/evidencia, notificaciones/tareas y huellas de integraciones SoftRestaurant/MPRO. Determinar capacidades reutilizables y ausencias solo a partir de metadatos SQL observados, sin DDL, DML, cambios de codigo ni Produccion.

queries.name: gate11_relevant_tables_inventory
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE t.name LIKE N'%Cava%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Rol%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Permiso%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Sesion%' OR t.name LIKE N'%PIN%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Mesa%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Comanda%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Mesero%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Inventario%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Botella%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Evidencia%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Foto%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Documento%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Notificacion%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Tarea%' OR t.name LIKE N'%SoftRestaurant%' OR t.name LIKE N'%MPRO%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name

queries.name: gate11_relevant_columns_inventory
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name LIKE N'%Cava%' OR t.name IN (N'Usuario_Catalogo',N'Cliente_Catalogo') OR t.name LIKE N'%Mesa%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Comanda%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Mesero%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Inventario%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Botella%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Evidencia%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Notificacion%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Tarea%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: gate11_capability_columns_by_semantics
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.name LIKE N'%email%' OR c.name LIKE N'%correo%' OR c.name LIKE N'%celular%' OR c.name LIKE N'%telefono%' OR c.name LIKE N'%activo%' OR c.name LIKE N'%mesa%' OR c.name LIKE N'%mesero%' OR c.name LIKE N'%botella%' OR c.name LIKE N'%capacidad%' OR c.name LIKE N'%fraccion%' OR c.name LIKE N'%ml%' OR c.name LIKE N'%qr%' OR c.name LIKE N'%evidencia%' OR c.name LIKE N'%foto%' OR c.name LIKE N'%documento%' OR c.name LIKE N'%confidence%' OR c.name LIKE N'%confianza%' OR c.name LIKE N'%calibr%' OR c.name LIKE N'%peso%' OR c.name LIKE N'%nivel%' OR c.name LIKE N'%aforo%' OR c.name LIKE N'%hash%' OR c.name LIKE N'%pin%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: gate11_keys_and_indexes_relevant
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, kc.name AS pk_name, i.name AS index_name, i.is_unique FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id LEFT JOIN sys.key_constraints kc ON kc.parent_object_id=t.object_id AND kc.type='PK' LEFT JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id AND i.index_id>0 AND i.is_hypothetical=0 WHERE t.name LIKE N'%Cava%' OR t.name IN (N'Usuario_Catalogo',N'Cliente_Catalogo') OR t.name LIKE N'%Mesa%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Comanda%' OR t.name LIKE N'%Inventario%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name,i.index_id

queries.name: gate11_foreign_keys_relevant
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS schema_name, OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_table, fk.name AS fk_name, OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) LIKE N'%Cava%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) LIKE N'%Cava%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) IN (N'Usuario_Catalogo',N'Cliente_Catalogo') OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) IN (N'Usuario_Catalogo',N'Cliente_Catalogo') ORDER BY parent_table,fk.name

queries.name: gate11_exact_canonical_object_presence
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.name=N'Usuario_Catalogo' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Usuario_Catalogo_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.name=N'Cliente_Catalogo' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Cliente_Catalogo_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.name LIKE N'CavaSocios%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CavaSocios_tables, SUM(CASE WHEN t.name LIKE N'CavasCorporativas%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CavasCorporativas_tables FROM sys.tables t

constraints: NO PII DATA READS; METADATA ONLY
NO schema names invented beyond metadata discovery and exact canonical catalogs already established
Do not create tables, columns, endpoints, migrations or persistence
Do not duplicate Cliente_Catalogo, Usuario_Catalogo, RBAC, CavaSocios or CavasCorporativas
Cava capacity means maximum count of physical bottles, distinct from nominal bottle volume in ml
Cavas operational human unit is bottle fraction 1, 3/4, 1/2, 1/4, 0; physical ml is evidence and does not silently overwrite operational state
SoftRestaurant and MPRO must be treated as peer adapters feeding canonical contracts, never as direct dependencies of Cavas
Report only observed metadata; absence in these queries means NOT_DETERMINABLE or MISSING only when directly supported
